description: $0.01 USDC on Solana per committee-level lookup - the payment buys one lookup in exactly one form: a committee profile by FEC committee id (identity factors plus committee-reported cycle aggregates and linked candidates), a name search (matching committees, capped at 25), or a cycle aggregate lookup (2024 or 2026), served from the D1 committee-level store (108,359 rows). Committee-level ONLY - itemized-donor data is statutorily barred (52 U.S.C. 30111(a)(4)) and never served.

committee_id.description: FEC committee id: the letter C followed by 8 digits (e.g. C00401224). Form (a) of the lookup; mutually exclusive with name_query.

cycle.description: Election cycle: 2024 or 2026. Optional with committee_id / name_query; on its own it is form (c), the cycle aggregate lookup.

name_query.description: Committee name search string, 2-80 characters. Form (b) of the lookup; mutually exclusive with committee_id.

name: fec_committees_lookup
